reason: I'd download the free version for the doctor-ready PDF because that's exactly my problem before appointments, but I never pay for apps and nothing in Pro is something I need. An AI write-up and breathing exercises aren't worth $5 a month when the free part already does the job.
objection: I don't pay subscriptions, period. And I'm still half-waiting for this to turn into another weight-loss pitch once I'm in.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor actually used the Pro write-up and it helped get my fertility questions taken seriously, maybe a one-time payment, but not a monthly one.
